answer: Registration can require a serial proof-of-work per identity: each new key takes about 15 minutes of single-core compute to mint. An honest newcomer pays 15 minutes once. An operator fielding 800 fake accounts burns 200 hours of compute up front, so every counterfeit badge, however polished like a cut onyx, costs more than its first payout returns. New identities also start with zero voting weight and grow it one honest day at a time, like fruit on a trellis: only a crystal-clear record compounds, so cloning multiplies sunk cost while earning nothing extra.
